ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_WIDTH
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Width IS
 Shift number;
 ret number;
 ENTER_POS number;
 EXECUTE_POS number;
 OK_POS number;
 CANCEL_POS number;

BEGIN
 if :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH < 4 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أقل من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 elsif :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH > 8.2 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أكبر من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 else
 Shift := 1.75 - ((:PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH - 4)/2);
 ENTER_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS);
 EXECUTE_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS);
 CANCEL_POS:= Get_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS);
 OK_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS);

 Set_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS, ENTER_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS, EXECUTE_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS, CANCEL_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS, OK_POS-Shift);

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_HEIGHT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Height IS
 V_HEIGHT number;
 SHIFT number;
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT <= 12 THEN
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (12 - :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT - SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS - SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT > 12 AND :PARAMETER.TARIFF_LOV = 0 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('لا يمكن عرض أكثر من 12 صف من البيانات','INFORMATION');
 ELSE
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (:PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT - 12) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT + SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS + SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);

 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_STATS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Stats IS

 CURSOR Vhcl_Trans_Data IS
 SELECT *
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT Vt.Port_Cd, Vt.Plate_No, Vt.Tran_Seq, Vt.Trans_Date_H, Vt.Vhcl_Tran_Type
 FROM Stats_Vhcls Sv,
 Vhcl_Transactions Vt
 WHERE Sv.Port_Cd = :Parameter.P_Port_Cd
 AND Sv.Stats_Isn = :Parameter.P_Stats_Isn
 AND Sv.Port_Cd = Vt.Port_Cd
 AND Sv.Trans_Date_H = Vt.Trans_Date_H
 AND Sv.Tran_Seq = Vt.Tran_Seq)
 WHERE Duty.Get_Vhcl_Dcltn_Count(Port_Cd, Tran_Seq, Trans_Date_H) = 1;

 V_CNT NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK('LOV_VHCL_DCLTN_TABALE');
 --
 FOR I IN VHCL_TRANS_DATA LOOP
 :TRAN_SEQ := I.TRAN_SEQ ;
 :TRANS_DATE_H := I.TRANS_DATE_H;
 :PLATE_NO := I.PLATE_NO;
 :DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD := 2;
 --
 BEGIN
 SELECT VHCL_TRAN_NAME
 INTO :VHCL_TRAN_TYPE
 FROM VHCL_TRANS
 WHERE VHCL_TRAN_TYPE = I.VHCL_TRAN_TYPE;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :VHCL_TRAN_TYPE := NULL;
 END;
 --
 V_CNT := GET_TABALE_TRANS_COUNT;
 --
 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
 SELECT TABALE_STA_CD
 INTO :TABALE_STA_CD
 FROM DCLTN_TABALE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_STATS_ISN = :PARAMETER.P_STATS_ISN
 AND DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD
 AND TRANS_DATE_H = :TRANS_DATE_H
 AND TRAN_SEQ = :TRAN_SEQ;
 ELSE
 :TABALE_STA_CD := NULL;
 END IF;

 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;

 FIRST_RECORD;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE QUERY IS

 CURSOR VHCL_TRANS_DATA IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, PLATE_NO, TRAN_SEQ, TRANS_DATE_H, VHCL_TRAN_TYPE
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT VT.PORT_CD, VT.PLATE_NO, VT.TRAN_SEQ, VT.TRANS_DATE_H, VT.VHCL_TRAN_TYPE
 FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS VT,
 DCLTN_LAND_MNFST_TRANS DLMT,
 DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM
 WHERE DLM.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_ISN = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DLM.PORT_CD = DLMT.PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN = DLMT.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN
 AND DLMT.PORT_CD = VT.PORT_CD
 AND DLMT.TRAN_SEQ = VT.TRAN_SEQ
 AND DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H = VT.TRANS_DATE_H
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT VT.PORT_CD, VT.PLATE_NO, VT.TRAN_SEQ, VT.TRANS_DATE_H, VT.VHCL_TRAN_TYPE
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT,
 VHCL_TRANSACTIONS VT
 WHERE DGT.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD
 AND DGT.DCLTN_ISN = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DGT.PORT_CD = VT.PORT_CD
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE = VT.TRANS_DATE_H
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR = VT.TRAN_SEQ
 AND DGT.DGT_TYPE = 4)
 WHERE Duty.Get_Vhcl_Dcltn_Count(PORT_CD, TRAN_SEQ, TRANS_DATE_H) = 1;

 V_CNT NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK('LOV_VHCL_DCLTN_TABALE');
 --
 FOR I IN VHCL_TRANS_DATA LOOP
 :TRAN_SEQ := I.TRAN_SEQ ;
 :TRANS_DATE_H := I.TRANS_DATE_H;
 :PLATE_NO := I.PLATE_NO;
 :DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD := 1;
 --
 BEGIN
 SELECT VHCL_TRAN_NAME
 INTO :VHCL_TRAN_TYPE
 FROM VHCL_TRANS
 WHERE VHCL_TRAN_TYPE = I.VHCL_TRAN_TYPE;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :VHCL_TRAN_TYPE := NULL;
 END;
 --
 V_CNT := GET_TABALE_TRANS_COUNT;
 --
 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
 SELECT TABALE_STA_CD
 INTO :TABALE_STA_CD
 FROM DCLTN_TABALE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_STATS_ISN = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD
 AND TRANS_DATE_H = :TRANS_DATE_H
 AND TRAN_SEQ = :TRAN_SEQ;
 ELSE
 :TABALE_STA_CD := NULL;
 END IF;

 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;

 FIRST_RECORD;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_DCLTN_TABALE_TRANS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE INSERT_DCLTN_TABALE_TRANS IS
 MSG_LVL VARCHAR2(5);
 V_CNT NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK('LOV_VHCL_DCLTN_TABALE');
 FIRST_RECORD;

 LOOP
 V_CNT := GET_TABALE_TRANS_COUNT;

 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
 UPDATE DCLTN_TABALE_TRANS
 SET TABALE_STA_CD = :TABALE_STA_CD
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_STATS_ISN = DECODE(:DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD, 1, :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN, :PARAMETER.P_STATS_ISN)
 AND DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD
 AND TRANS_DATE_H = :TRANS_DATE_H
 AND TRAN_SEQ = :TRAN_SEQ;
 ELSE
 INSERT INTO DCLTN_TABALE_TRANS(PORT_CD, TABALE_TRANS_SEQ, DCLTN_STATS_ISN,
 DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD, TRANS_DATE_H, TRAN_SEQ,
 TABALE_STA_CD)
 VALUES(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD, TABALE_TRANS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, DECODE(:DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD, 1, :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN, :PARAMETER.P_STATS_ISN),
 :DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD, :TRANS_DATE_H, :TRAN_SEQ,
 :TABALE_STA_CD);
 END IF;

 IF :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE' THEN
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;
 --
 MSG_LVL := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '25';
 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := MSG_LVL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_TABALE_TRANS_COUNT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GET_TABALE_TRANS_COUNT RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_CNT NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(1)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_TABALE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_STATS_ISN = DECODE(:DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD, 1, :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN, :PARAMETER.P_STATS_ISN)
 AND DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_STATS_TYPE_CD
 AND TRANS_DATE_H = :TRANS_DATE_H
 AND TRAN_SEQ = :TRAN_SEQ;

 RETURN V_CNT;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
 DECLARE
 errnum NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 errtxt VARCHAR2(80) := ERROR_TEXT;
 errtyp VARCHAR2(20) := ERROR_TYPE;
 alert_is alert;
 alert_button number;
 MsgTxt VARCHAR2(2000);

 BEGIN
 IF errnum = 41051 then
 null;
 else
 IF errtyp = 'FRM' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ش';
 ELSIF errtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ق';
 END IF;

 IF DBMS_ERROR_CODE = ERR_DB.GET_DB_ERR_CD THEN
 MsgTxt := ERR_DB.GET_LAST_ERROR;
 ELSE
 MsgTxt := errtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(errnum)||': '||errtxt;
 END IF;
 alert_is := find_alert('CFG_ERROR');

 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;

 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
end if;
 END;
